summary: Extracted insertOrdered/countExpired, used imported types, documented tie-breaking and hold-back rule; behavior unchanged.
findings: Insertion uses binary search (O(log n) search, O(n) shift); stable for equal timestamps (upper bound).
Hold-back rule (count==1, inserted first, others buffered) looks like a green-phase special case; preserved because tests depend on it.
Buffer unbounded; capacity bounding is outside signature scope.
changes: Replaced fully-qualified java.util names with imports
Split accept into insertOrdered and countExpired
